title: Ten Common Words
subtitle: hir, hem, swich, yif, eek — high-frequency Middle English.
objectives: Read and translate authentic Middle English texts.
Prepare for sustained reading in Stage 3.

sections.heading: Content
sections.body: hir (her, their), hem (them), swich (such), yif (if), eek (also), biforn (before), wyf (wife, woman), knyght (knight), soothly (truly), ful (very, full). Practice pronunciation and spelling recognition. These appear on every page of Chaucer.

items.prompt: What is the focus of this lesson?
Can you apply this to reading?
items.answer: Work through examples with your notes.

lesson_completion.criteria: Mark complete when you understand Ten Common Words.
